# creation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeCreation`](gmeow-eventTypeCreation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeCreation>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The event of an entity coming into existence — the universal form of birth (person), founding (organization), minting (currency), or realization (reference frame).

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:eventTypeCreation`](gmeow-eventTypeCreation.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md).
